exposure: middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA-PI) <10th percentile in pregnancies with idiopathic polyhydramnios
outcome: composite adverse perinatal outcome (Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, umbilical artery pH <7.15, emergent caesarean delivery or operative delivery due to foetal distress, neonatal intensive care admission or foetal death)
operative delivery due to foetal distress
cohort: The study included 128 singleton pregnancies affected by idiopathic polyhydramnios.
finding: Pregnancies with MCA-PI <10th percentile had significantly higher rates of emergent caesarean delivery and composite adverse perinatal outcomes compared to those with MCA-PI >=10th percentile.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with MCA-PI <10th percentile experienced higher rates of emergent caesarean delivery or operative delivery due to foetal distress.
